title: Simple Epidemic Simulation Model
description: Model the spread of a virus in a population of 1000 people.

interactions.name: virus_transmission
interactions.description: The process through which a virus is transmitted from one person to another.

metrics.name: total_infected
metrics.description: The total number of people who have been infected during the simulation.

metrics.name: peak_infection_day
metrics.description: The day on which the highest number of new infections occur.

metrics.name: recovered_count
metrics.description: The total number of people who have recovered from the virus.

validation_criteria.name: infection_peak_check
validation_criteria.description: Ensure the peak infection day aligns with expected epidemiological models.

validation_criteria.name: final_size_check
validation_criteria.description: Validate that the final number of infected matches expected outcomes given the parameters.
